description: This file defines the login functionality for users in the project, including data models, validation, and request handling logic.

classes.name: Login.UserData
classes.description: Data transfer object containing user's email and password for login.

classes.name: Login.Command
classes.description: Record representing the login request command, encapsulating user data.

classes.name: Login.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validator enforcing rules on the login command fields.

classes.name: Login.Handler
classes.description: Handles login requests by validating user credentials and returning a user envelope with a token.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes login commands; verifies credentials and generates a JWT token.
